verses.web: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

verses.web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
verses.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

verses.web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
verses.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

verses.web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;
verses.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

verses.web: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
verses.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

verses.web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
verses.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

verses.web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
verses.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

verses.web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verses.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

verses.web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
verses.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

verses.web: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.
verses.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

verses.web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
verses.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

verses.web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,
verses.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,

verses.web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
verses.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

verses.web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
verses.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

verses.web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
verses.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

verses.web: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.
verses.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

verses.web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
verses.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

verses.web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
verses.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

verses.web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
verses.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:

verses.web: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
verses.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

verses.web: And they glorified God in me.
verses.kjv: And they glorified God in me.

verses.web: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
verses.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

verses.web: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
verses.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

verses.web: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
verses.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

verses.web: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;
verses.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

verses.web: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
verses.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

verses.web: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
verses.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

verses.web: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision
verses.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

verses.web: (for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles);
verses.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

verses.web: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
verses.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

verses.web: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
verses.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

verses.web: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
verses.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

verses.web: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
verses.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

verses.web: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
verses.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

verses.web: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
verses.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

verses.web: “We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,
verses.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

verses.web: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
verses.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

verses.web: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
verses.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

verses.web: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
verses.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

verses.web: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.
verses.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

verses.web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
verses.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

verses.web: I don’t make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
verses.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

verses.web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
verses.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

verses.web: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.web: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
verses.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

verses.web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
verses.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

verses.web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
verses.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.web: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
verses.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

verses.web: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.
verses.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

verses.web: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
verses.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

verses.web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
verses.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

verses.web: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
verses.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

verses.web: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
verses.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

verses.web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
verses.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

verses.web: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
verses.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

verses.web: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

verses.web: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.
verses.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

verses.web: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn’t say, “To seeds”, as of many, but as of one, “To your seed”, which is Christ.
verses.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

verses.web: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
verses.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

verses.web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
verses.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

verses.web: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
verses.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

verses.web: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
verses.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

verses.web: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
verses.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

verses.web: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
verses.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

verses.web: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

verses.web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

verses.web: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
verses.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

verses.web: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.web: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

verses.web: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.web: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to promise.
verses.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

verses.web: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;
verses.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

verses.web: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
verses.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

verses.web: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
verses.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

verses.web: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
verses.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

verses.web: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.
verses.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

verses.web: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
verses.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

verses.web: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

verses.web: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
verses.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

verses.web: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
verses.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

verses.web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
verses.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

verses.web: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
verses.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

verses.web: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
verses.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

verses.web: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
verses.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

verses.web: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

verses.web: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

verses.web: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

verses.web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
verses.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

verses.web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

verses.web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
verses.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

verses.web: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
verses.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

verses.web: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
verses.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

verses.web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.
verses.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

verses.web: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
verses.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

verses.web: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
verses.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

verses.web: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
verses.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

verses.web: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

verses.web: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.”
verses.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

verses.web: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
verses.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

verses.web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
verses.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

verses.web: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
verses.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

verses.web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.
verses.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

verses.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
verses.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

verses.web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
verses.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

verses.web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

verses.web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
verses.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

verses.web: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
verses.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

verses.web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
verses.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

verses.web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
verses.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

verses.web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
verses.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

verses.web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
verses.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

verses.web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
verses.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

verses.web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
verses.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

verses.web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
verses.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

verses.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
verses.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

verses.web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
verses.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

verses.web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
verses.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

verses.web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
verses.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

verses.web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

verses.web: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
verses.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

verses.web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
verses.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

verses.web: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.
verses.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

verses.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
verses.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

verses.web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verses.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

verses.web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
verses.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

verses.web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
verses.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

verses.web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
verses.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

verses.web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
verses.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

verses.web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

verses.web: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

verses.web: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.
verses.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

verses.web: For each man will bear his own burden.
verses.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.

verses.web: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
verses.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

verses.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
verses.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

verses.web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
verses.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

verses.web: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
verses.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.web: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
verses.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

verses.web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
verses.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

verses.web: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

verses.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

verses.web: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

verses.web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
verses.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

verses.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
verses.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

verses.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
verses.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
